SELECT g.player_id, g.death_country, g.group_count, 1.0 * g.group_count / NULLIF(t.country_total, 0) AS ratio
FROM (
  SELECT ma.player_id, p.death_country, COUNT(*) AS group_count
  FROM manager_award AS ma
  JOIN player AS p ON ma.player_id = p.player_id COLLATE BINARY
  GROUP BY ma.player_id, p.death_country
) AS g
JOIN (
  SELECT death_country, SUM(group_count) AS country_total
  FROM (
    SELECT ma.player_id, p.death_country, COUNT(*) AS group_count
    FROM manager_award AS ma
    JOIN player AS p ON ma.player_id = p.player_id COLLATE BINARY
    GROUP BY ma.player_id, p.death_country
  )
  GROUP BY death_country
) AS t ON g.death_country = t.death_country COLLATE BINARY
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
